in_marathi.name: Brahmadev
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of creation and knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brahmadev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brahmadev is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'the lord of creation and knowledge'. In Hindu mythology, Brahmadev is considered to be the creator of the universe. He is one of the trinity gods in Hinduism, alongside Vishnu and Shiva.
